disciplinary.en: The school formed a disciplinary committee to review the repeated rule violations.
disciplinary.zh: 學校成立紀律委員會，審查反覆違規的情況。

discourage.en: A single low score should not discourage you from continuing to improve.
discourage.zh: 一次低分不應該讓你失去繼續進步的信心。

discouragement.en: Her teacher offered support when discouragement made studying feel unusually difficult.
discouragement.zh: 當挫折感讓讀書變得特別困難時，老師給了她支持。

discourse.en: The class compared formal discourse with casual conversation in everyday situations.
discourse.zh: 課堂比較正式論述與日常情境中的隨意對話。

discreet.en: The counselor was discreet when discussing the student's private concern.
discreet.zh: 輔導老師在談論學生的私人困擾時十分謹慎。

discriminate.en: Good readers learn to discriminate between reliable evidence and weak claims.
discriminate.zh: 優秀的讀者會學著分辨可靠證據與薄弱主張。

disgust.en: The smell from the spoiled food caused immediate disgust among the students.
disgust.zh: 壞掉食物的氣味立刻讓學生感到厭惡。

dismiss.en: The teacher did not dismiss the question and explained it carefully.
dismiss.zh: 老師沒有忽視那個問題，而是仔細加以說明。

dispensable.en: Some decorative details are dispensable when time for the project is limited.
dispensable.zh: 當專題時間有限時，有些裝飾性細節可以省略。

disposable.en: The school reduced its use of disposable cups during campus events.
disposable.zh: 學校在校園活動中減少使用一次性杯子。

dissent.en: The discussion allowed respectful dissent without turning into a personal argument.
dissent.zh: 這場討論允許有禮貌的異議，而不演變成人身爭執。

dissolve.en: Salt will dissolve more quickly in warm water than in cold water.
dissolve.zh: 鹽在溫水中會比在冷水中溶解得更快。

distinct.en: The two species have distinct patterns that make identification easier.
distinct.zh: 這兩個物種有明顯不同的花紋，因此更容易辨認。

distinction.en: The essay explains the distinction between correlation and direct causation.
distinction.zh: 這篇文章說明相關性與直接因果關係之間的差異。

distinguished.en: A distinguished scientist visited the school to speak about climate research.
distinguished.zh: 一位傑出的科學家到校分享氣候研究。

distraction.en: Turning off notifications can reduce distraction while you are studying.
distraction.zh: 關閉通知可以減少讀書時的干擾。

disturb.en: Please speak quietly so you do not disturb students in the library.
disturb.zh: 請小聲說話，以免打擾圖書館裡的學生。

disturbance.en: The sudden disturbance outside briefly interrupted the science presentation.
disturbance.zh: 外面的突發騷動短暫打斷了科學簡報。

ditch.en: Rainwater collected in a shallow ditch beside the country road.
ditch.zh: 雨水積在鄉間道路旁的一條淺溝裡。

dive.en: The penguin can dive deep into the ocean in search of food.
dive.zh: 企鵝能潛入海洋深處尋找食物。

diversify.en: The company plans to diversify its products to reach more customers.
diversify.zh: 公司計畫讓產品更多元，以接觸更多顧客。

diversion.en: The construction created a temporary diversion for traffic near the station.
diversion.zh: 施工使車站附近的交通暫時改道。

dividend.en: The company announced a small dividend after reporting a profitable year.
dividend.zh: 公司在公布獲利年度後宣布發放小額股利。

divine.en: The ancient poem describes a king who believed he had divine protection.
divine.zh: 這首古詩描述一位相信自己受到神聖庇護的國王。

division.en: Clear division of tasks helped the team finish the project on time.
division.zh: 清楚分工幫助團隊準時完成專題。

do.en: Students do better when they review difficult material in short sessions.
do.zh: 學生把困難內容分成短時間複習時，通常表現更好。

doc.en: The shared doc contains the latest notes from our group discussion.
doc.zh: 這份共用文件包含我們小組討論的最新筆記。

dodge.en: The cyclist had to dodge a fallen branch on the path.
dodge.zh: 騎士不得不閃過小徑上的一根倒下樹枝。

doll.en: The museum displayed a handmade doll from the early twentieth century.
doll.zh: 博物館展出一個二十世紀初的手工娃娃。

dollar.en: The price increased by one dollar after the discount period ended.
dollar.zh: 折扣期結束後，價格上漲了一美元。

dolphin.en: A dolphin surfaced beside the boat before swimming back into deeper water.
dolphin.zh: 一隻海豚在船邊浮出水面，之後游回較深的水域。

dome.en: The old library has a glass dome above its central reading room.
dome.zh: 老圖書館的中央閱覽室上方有一座玻璃圓頂。

dominate.en: One topic should not dominate the entire group discussion.
dominate.zh: 一個主題不應主導整場小組討論。

donate.en: Students can donate used books to the community reading program.
donate.zh: 學生可以把二手書捐給社區閱讀計畫。

donkey.en: The farmer used a donkey to carry supplies along the narrow trail.
donkey.zh: 農夫用驢子沿著狹窄山徑搬運物資。

doom.en: The article rejects the idea that one mistake will doom the project.
doom.zh: 這篇文章否定一次錯誤就會注定專題失敗的想法。

doorway.en: She paused in the doorway before entering the crowded classroom.
doorway.zh: 她在門口停了一下，才走進擁擠的教室。

dorm.en: The new dorm includes a quiet room for evening study.
dorm.zh: 新宿舍設有一間供晚間讀書使用的安靜房間。

dormitory.en: The university built a dormitory within walking distance of the library.
dormitory.zh: 大學在步行可到圖書館的地方興建了一棟宿舍。

dot.en: Place a small dot beside each answer you want to review later.
dot.zh: 在你想稍後複習的每個答案旁標上一個小點。

dough.en: The baker covered the dough and left it to rise for an hour.
dough.zh: 麵包師蓋住麵糰，讓它發酵一小時。

doughnut.en: He bought a doughnut and a carton of milk after class.
doughnut.zh: 他下課後買了一個甜甜圈和一盒牛奶。

dove.en: A white dove landed quietly on the roof of the old building.
dove.zh: 一隻白鴿安靜地停在老建築的屋頂上。

downstairs.en: The computer lab is downstairs beside the main office.
downstairs.zh: 電腦教室在樓下，位於辦公室旁邊。

downtown.en: The bus reaches downtown in about twenty minutes during the morning.
downtown.zh: 早上搭公車約二十分鐘可以到市中心。

downwards.en: The graph moves downwards as the temperature gradually decreases.
downwards.zh: 隨著溫度逐漸下降，圖表的線條向下移動。

doze.en: He began to doze during the long ride home after practice.
doze.zh: 練習後回家的長途車程中，他開始打瞌睡。

dragon.en: The story features a dragon that guards a hidden mountain lake.
dragon.zh: 故事中有一條守護隱密高山湖泊的龍。

dragonfly.en: A bright dragonfly rested on a leaf beside the pond.
dragonfly.zh: 一隻鮮豔的蜻蜓停在池塘旁的葉子上。

drama.en: The drama club will perform a short play at the school festival.
drama.zh: 戲劇社將在校慶演出一齣短劇。

draught.en: A cold draught came through the open window during the meeting.
draught.zh: 會議進行時，一股冷風從開著的窗戶吹進來。

drawer.en: She kept the spare batteries in the top drawer of the desk.
drawer.zh: 她把備用電池放在書桌最上層的抽屜裡。

drawing.en: His drawing shows how the bridge supports weight from both sides.
drawing.zh: 他的圖畫呈現橋梁如何從兩側支撐重量。

dreadful.en: The weather was dreadful, so the outdoor event moved indoors.
dreadful.zh: 天氣非常糟，因此戶外活動改到室內舉行。

dresser.en: The lamp stood on a small dresser beside the bed.
dresser.zh: 檯燈放在床邊的一個小梳妝櫃上。

dressing.en: She added a light dressing to the salad before serving it.
dressing.zh: 她上菜前在沙拉上加了一點清爽醬汁。

drill.en: The school held a fire drill during the second class period.
drill.zh: 學校在第二節課進行消防演練。

drip.en: A slow drip from the faucet continued throughout the night.
drip.zh: 水龍頭整晚都持續緩慢滴水。

driveway.en: A delivery truck stopped briefly in front of the driveway.
driveway.zh: 一輛送貨卡車短暫停在車道前。

drugstore.en: The drugstore near the station also sells basic household supplies.
drugstore.zh: 車站附近的藥局也販售基本家庭用品。

drum.en: The drummer struck the drum softly during the quiet opening section.
drum.zh: 鼓手在安靜的開場段落中輕輕敲鼓。

dryer.en: The wet towels were placed in the dryer after practice.
dryer.zh: 練習後，濕毛巾被放進烘乾機。

dual.en: The device has a dual purpose as both a clock and timer.
dual.zh: 這個裝置具有時鐘和計時器的雙重用途。

dubious.en: The editor rejected the claim because its evidence seemed dubious.
dubious.zh: 編輯拒絕那項說法，因為其證據看起來不可靠。

duck.en: A duck crossed the path while students were walking around the lake.
duck.zh: 學生繞湖散步時，一隻鴨子穿過小徑。

dull.en: The lecture became less dull after the teacher added real examples.
dull.zh: 老師加入真實例子後，這堂講課變得沒那麼無聊。

dumb.en: The device is simple, but calling it dumb would be misleading.
dumb.zh: 這個裝置雖然簡單，但稱它愚笨並不恰當。

dump.en: The city plans to close the old dump and restore the land.
dump.zh: 市政府計畫關閉舊垃圾場並復育土地。

dumpling.en: She ordered a vegetable dumpling with her bowl of soup.
dumpling.zh: 她點了一顆蔬菜水餃搭配一碗湯。

durable.en: This backpack is durable enough for daily use throughout the school year.
durable.zh: 這個背包夠耐用，能應付整個學年的日常使用。

dusk.en: The hikers reached the village just before dusk.
dusk.zh: 登山客在黃昏前不久抵達村莊。

dusty.en: The old shelves were dusty after years without regular cleaning.
dusty.zh: 那些舊書架多年沒有定期清潔，因此布滿灰塵。

dwarf.en: A small tree may dwarf nearby flowers without growing very tall.
dwarf.zh: 一棵小樹即使不算高，也可能讓附近花朵顯得十分矮小。

dwell.en: The article does not dwell on minor errors in the earlier study.
dwell.zh: 這篇文章沒有過度著墨先前研究中的小錯誤。

dye.en: The artist used natural dye to color the fabric a deep blue.
dye.zh: 藝術家用天然染料把布染成深藍色。

dynasty.en: The museum exhibition explores art from an ancient dynasty.
dynasty.zh: 博物館展覽介紹某個古代王朝的藝術。

eagle.en: An eagle circled above the valley before disappearing behind the ridge.
eagle.zh: 一隻老鷹在山谷上空盤旋，之後消失在山脊後方。

earnest.en: Her earnest effort impressed the judges even before the final result.
earnest.zh: 她認真的努力在最終結果公布前就打動了評審。
